findings.description: Criterion 4 (collected evidence advances a loop only after both schema validation and gate validation pass) is enforced in production for exactly one of five adapters. evidence_gate.validate_advancement — the function documented in the module's own docstring as the 'Path 1: Collected-evidence (herdr/Cowork adapter)' advancement gate — has zero production callers anywhere in the repository; every call site is in platforms/python/tests/test_evidence_gate.py. evidence_gate.validate_loop_complete_advancement is called from exactly one place: platforms/claude-code/commands/next-loop.md. Codex, OpenCode, Cursor and Cowork have no advancement-gate call anywhere in their platform trees, and the gap is undocumented: docs/adapting-to-new-platforms.md and each adapter's own README.md contain no mention of evidence_gate, validate_advancement, or an advancement gate of any kind (they discuss only the separate, manual 'human gate'). loop-007-3's own check required this gap to be either closed or named in the docs as a scope decision; it is neither, which by that check's own wording is the defect, not a documented exception.
findings.evidence: Grep for 'validate_loop_complete_advancement|validate_advancement|validate_path_scope' across the whole worktree returns 7 files, of which only evidence_gate.py itself, scope_policy.py, platforms/claude-code/commands/next-loop.md, CHANGELOG.md and the two test files match — platforms/codex, platforms/opencode, platforms/cursor and platforms/cowork are absent from that list entirely. Grep for 'validate_advancement(' or 'can_advance_loop(' outside tests/ returns only its own definitions and internal wrapper call inside evidence_gate.py (lines 37, 40, 113, 150, 154) — no adapter command file calls it. Grep for 'evidence_gate|advancement' (case-insensitive) in docs/adapting-to-new-platforms.md and in platforms/codex/README.md, platforms/opencode/README.md, platforms/cursor/README.md returns zero matches in every file; each README's only 'gate' hits are about the manual human review gate ($advanced-planning gate current, Human Gate Blocking), a different mechanism from the automated schema+policy advancement gate the criterion names.

findings.description: Criterion 1 (every target host discovers the same named core planning skills, not host-specific copies that drift) was measured by loop-005-4 to FAIL: opencode resolves claude-code's .claude/skills copy rather than its own adapter's directory (F20); claude and cursor serve a global profile's skill copy over the project's (F21); cursor's reported skill list is unstable across identical invocations (F23). loop-007-6 was opened specifically to determine, per finding, whether each is a fixable adapter defect or an unfixable host constraint, and to re-run the four-host digest table under a fake HOME. It remains status: pending, gate: human in loops.md, and no work discharging it exists in the worktree.
findings.evidence: loops.md:1096-1117 — loop-007-6's YAML block shows `status: pending`, `gate: "human"`, and no `landed:` or `result:` field (contrast with loop-007-1 through loop-007-5, each of which carries a `landed:` line naming a commit). A repository-wide search for 'loop-007-6', 'F20', 'F21', 'F23' (the finding IDs the remediation todo itself names as its subject) returns matches only inside advanced-planning's own unrelated self-hosted .advanced-plans/phases/phase-2/loops.md, a different document describing a different, 16-phase self-hosting programme — not phase 6 of the AAW controller programme under review.

findings.description: Criterion 2 (a fixture programme can create one phase, one loop, and one external task on every target host) is incomplete on two of four hosts. loop-004-4 recorded that codex stopped after phase creation and did not decompose a loop or emit an envelope, a human decision made because the codex account stood at 98% of its weekly quota. loop-005-3 recorded that cursor could not run any shell command on this machine (a PreToolUse hook incompatibility) and stopped at step 3 of 4, writing BLOCKED.md rather than completing. loop-007-7 was opened to finish both hosts by pre-authorising dialogs rather than answering them, and remains status: pending, gate: human.
findings.evidence: loops.md:1118-1137 — loop-007-7's YAML block shows `status: pending`, `gate: "human"`, no `landed:` field. loop-004-4's own result text (loops.md:611) states 'CHECK 1 IS SATISFIED ON OPENCODE ONLY' and names the codex quota block explicitly. loop-005-3's own result text (loops.md:744) states 'step 4 BLOCKED and recorded as BLOCKED.md rather than faked' and names the PreToolUse/PowerShell/POSIX-shell incompatibility as the cause. No artefact, commit, or evidence-file reference to loop-007-7 exists anywhere in the worktree.

failure_notes: Wire (or explicitly, visibly document the deliberate exclusion of) the advancement gate — validate_advancement or validate_loop_complete_advancement — for platforms/cowork, platforms/codex, platforms/opencode and platforms/cursor. Today only platforms/claude-code/commands/next-loop.md calls either function in production; validate_advancement (the function documented for the herdr/Cowork path) has no production caller at all.

Complete loop-007-6 (host-discovery remediation, criterion 1) and loop-007-7 (fixture-programme completion on codex and cursor, criterion 2) before re-gating. Both remain status: pending with gate: human and carry no landed work in this worktree; a third fail on these two criteria without new evidence is not a surprise.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Every target host discovers the same named core planning skills — not host-specific copies that drift.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: loop-005-4 (loops.md:748-767) measured this criterion to FAIL: opencode resolves .claude/skills (claude-code's copy) rather than its own adapter directory (F20); claude and cursor serve a global profile copy over the project's under a real HOME (F21); cursor's skill list is unstable across identical runs (F23). loop-007-6, opened to remediate, remains `status: pending`, `gate: human` at loops.md:1096-1117 with no landed commit and no matching evidence anywhere in the worktree.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: A fixture programme can create one phase, one loop, and one external task on every target host.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: loop-004-4 (loops.md:597-616) reports the check satisfied on opencode only, with codex stopped after phase creation due to quota. loop-005-3 (loops.md:729-747) reports cursor blocked at step 3 of 4 by a PreToolUse hook incompatibility, recorded as BLOCKED.md. loop-007-7, opened to complete both hosts, remains `status: pending`, `gate: human` at loops.md:1118-1137 with no landed work.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Only the control checkout updates programme state; a worker attempting a planning-state edit fails collection — ACC-08.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: platforms/python/evidence_gate.py:242 and :437 call scope_policy.validate_path_scope from the two production advancement functions. platforms/claude-code/commands/next-loop.md:397-413 (Step 7a) is a real production caller: it derives changed_paths from `git diff --name-only` via default_worker_scope('.') and calls validate_loop_complete_advancement, halting (SystemExit 1) and naming the offending path when a forbidden path such as .advanced-plans/state/ is touched (next-loop.md:419-424 documents this as the ACC-08 case explicitly). platforms/python/tests/test_scope_policy.py:340-505 (TestNegativeAssertion_ProductionCaller and TestPositiveControl_ProductionCaller) drive this exact production entry point with both a forbidden-path negative case and a clean positive control, rather than a pure function that opens no file. The one documented loose end — next-loop.md's worker still writes .advanced-plans/state/loop-complete.json directly rather than emitting a collected-evidence document per the migrated core/agents/worker.md contract — is not hidden: scope_policy.py:31-48 names it explicitly as a carve-out with the reason (next-loop.md was never migrated) and records it as a Phase 7 item, and no other forbidden path (loop-ready.json, PLANNING.md, history.jsonl, gate-verdicts/, evidence/, .claude/settings.json) is exempted.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Collected evidence advances a loop only after both schema validation and gate validation pass.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: evidence_gate.validate_advancement (documented as the Cowork/herdr collected-evidence path) has zero production callers — every call site found by grep is in platforms/python/tests/test_evidence_gate.py. evidence_gate.validate_loop_complete_advancement is called from exactly one adapter, platforms/claude-code/commands/next-loop.md:400. Grep for evidence_gate/validate_advancement/validate_loop_complete_advancement across platforms/codex/, platforms/opencode/, platforms/cursor/ and platforms/cowork/ returns no matches in any of the four. docs/adapting-to-new-platforms.md and the three adapters' own README.md files contain no reference to an advancement gate at all — the gap loop-007-3's own check required to be fixed or documented is present and undocumented.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: The CI path audit fails on any host-specific path in core/.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: platforms/python/path_audit.py:168-178 — DEFAULT_SCANNED_ROOTS includes core/schemas, core/state, platforms/cursor and setup/cursor (the four roots loop-007-4 targeted, alongside the pre-existing core/agents and core/skills). platforms/python/tests/test_path_audit.py:780-824 contain a dedicated red-green pair for each new root — test_core_schemas_root_goes_red, test_core_state_root_goes_red, test_platforms_cursor_root_goes_red, test_setup_cursor_root_goes_red — plus test_the_clean_tree_is_green, matching the check's requirement that each new root be proven able to fail before being trusted to pass.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: No adapter duplicates a core skill's content; adapters install and register, they do not fork.
criteria_outcomes.evidence: Glob for SKILL.md under platforms/codex, platforms/opencode and platforms/cursor returns zero files — no adapter source tree ships a forked copy; skills are installed from core/skills/ (9 canonical SKILL.md files present, confirmed by Glob) and platforms/shared/agent-skills/ at install time. This is consistent with the controller-verified digest proofs recorded in loop-004-2 (loops.md:549), loop-004-3 (loops.md:570) and loop-005-2 (loops.md:725), and this was the one criterion attempt 1's three reviewers passed unanimously (loops.md:1198-1201), needing no loop-007 remediation.
